# Growth & engagement blocks

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-skill-references.ts from the block manifests. -->

The Growth & engagement blocks of this version of better-supabase, from the block manifests. Install one with `npx better-supabase add <block>`; the docs page of each block has the method signatures. Entity names are the defaults; an app can rename them under `blocks.<name>.names`.

## flags

Feature flags with variants, targeting rules over tenant, user, plan, role, custom contexts such as brand and shared segments, overrides, and a scheduled percentage rollout split across weighted variants, bucketed by SHA-256. Every save records a revision you can restore. flag_enabled() goes in policies; createFlagsProvider() evaluates the same way for OpenFeature and the Flags SDK.

- Title: Feature flags
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/flags
- Client: `flagsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/flags`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`
- Works with: `permissions`, `entitlements`
- Entities: `flag`
- Tables: `flags`
- Permission keys: `flags.manage`
- Events (`FlagsEvents`): `flag.created`, `flag.deleted`, `flag.override_changed`, `flag.updated`

## onboarding

Onboarding checklists per user or organization, run as enrollment programs: the completed steps, completed by hand or by an outbox event type. Organization checklists check onboarding.read and onboarding.complete.

- Title: Onboarding
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/onboarding
- Client: `onboardingBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/onboarding`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `enrollments`
- Works with: `outbox`

## waitlist

A waitlist with positions and approvals, and hashed invite codes with a use limit, an expiry and an optional organization and role. waitlist_admit() backs a before-user-created hook that only lets approved addresses or valid codes sign up.

- Title: Waitlist and invite codes
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/waitlist
- Client: `waitlistBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/waitlist`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `invitations`, `organizations`
- Entities: `waitlist_entry`
- Tables: `waitlist_entries`
- Permission keys: `waitlist.manage`, `waitlist.invite`
- Events (`WaitlistEvents`): `invite_code.created`, `invite_code.revoked`, `organization.member_added`, `waitlist_entry.approved`, `waitlist_entry.rejected`

## announcements

In-app announcements for everyone, tenants, roles or plans within a time window, with per-user dismissals and a Realtime broadcast when they change. Staff manage them with announcements.manage on the platform.

- Title: Announcements
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/announcements
- Client: `announcementsBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/announcements`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`
- Works with: `entitlements`
- Entities: `announcement`
- Tables: `announcements`
- Permission keys: `announcements.manage`
- Events (`AnnouncementsEvents`): `announcement.archived`, `announcement.created`, `announcement.purged`, `announcement.restored`, `announcement.updated`

## scores

Tenant-editable scoring models: rules (a filter tree over the rules field catalog worth points) and metrics (a number times a weight, or a record's vote score) that write versioned scores with bands to any subject. Lead scoring and health scoring are models.

- Title: Scores
- Docs: https://bettersupabase.com/docs/blocks/scores
- Client: `scoresBlock` from `better-supabase/blocks/scores`
- Modes: `managed`, `custom`
- Requires: `memberships`, `permissions`, `automations`
- Works with: `reactions`, `outbox`, `audit`
- Entities: `score_model`
- Tables: `score_models`
- Permission keys: `scores.read`, `scores.manage`, `scores.compute`
- Events (`ScoresEvents`): `score.changed`, `score_model.archived`, `score_model.created`, `score_model.purged`, `score_model.restored`, `score_model.updated`
